cover: RAG or fine-tuning: which one your data needs

slides.title: RAG controls what it knows
slides.body: The system looks up relevant passages each time someone asks, and the model answers from them.

slides.title: Fine-tuning controls how it answers
slides.body: Training on examples changes format, tone and judgment. It is a poor way to teach a model facts.

slides.title: Facts change, tuned models don't
slides.body: Update a policy and a tuned model keeps the old one until you retrain it. RAG uses the new version on the next question.

slides.title: When tuning earns its place
slides.body: The model knows the right thing but says it in the wrong shape, thousands of times a day.

slides.title: The platforms are shifting
slides.body: OpenAI closed fine-tuning to new organizations in May 2026. Keep your dataset and test set so you can move.
